    AI Overview
    American Idol 2026 voting for the Top 20 is open until 6 a.m. ET on Tuesday, March 24, with three ways to vote:
    online at AmericanIdol.com/vote, text, and social media. You can cast up to 10 votes per contestant per method (online, text, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok). The Top 14 will be revealed in the March 30 episode. 
    How to Vote (Season 24 - 2026): 
    • Online: Visit americanidol.com/vote to cast votes for your favorite performers.
    • Text: Text the contestant's assigned number to 21523.
    • Social Media: Find the "Official Vote Post" on the official American Idol Facebook, Instagram, or TikTok accounts and comment the contestant's name. 
    Voting Rules: 
    • Limits: You can cast 10 votes per contestant per method.
    • Eligibility: Must be 16+ and located in the U.S., Puerto Rico, or the Virgin Islands.
    • Deadline: Voting generally closes at 6 a.m. ET the morning after performances.
    • Note: The American Idol app is no longer used for voting. 
    Disclaimer: Voting information is based on the 2026 season as of March 23, 2026.
